title: Formulae for indices of holomorphic foliations via reduction of singularities
summary: We study numerical invariants associated with the reduction of singularities of holomorphic foliation germs on $(\mathbb{C}^2, 0)$. Building on our previous work on generalized curve foliations, we extend explicit formulas for several fundamental invariants to arbitrary foliations. In particular, we provide general expressions for the discrepancy vector, the Milnor and intrinsic Milnor numbers, and classical indices along a separatrix as Camacho-Sad, Variation, Gómez-Mont-Seade-Verjovsky and also the Baum-Bott index.
